departments.name: Billing & Revenue Assurance
departments.description: Manages all customer-facing financial transactions including invoice generation, payment processing, dispute resolution, credit adjustments, refunds, and proactive billing accuracy assurance.

departments.name: Network Operations & Engineering
departments.description: Responsible for the health, performance, and reliability of NexaLink's mobile and fixed-line network infrastructure. Handles outage investigation, signal quality improvement, speed escalations, roaming partner coordination, and planned maintenance communications.

departments.name: Device & Warranty Services
departments.description: Oversees all matters related to NexaLink-sold or leased hardware including routers, set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Manages warranty claims, device swap logistics, defect triage, and repair coordination with third-party service centers.

departments.name: Account Management & Provisioning
departments.description: Handles all aspects of subscriber account lifecycle: onboarding, plan changes, profile updates, multi-line management, SIM provisioning, number portability, and account suspensions or terminations.

departments.name: Account Security & Fraud Prevention
departments.description: Investigates and mitigates account takeovers, SIM swap fraud, unauthorized port-outs, identity theft, and premium rate fraud. Works in conjunction with law enforcement agencies and industry anti-fraud bodies as required.
departments.notes: 24/7 rapid-response team. Highest priority SLA across all departments.

departments.name: Content & Streaming Services
departments.description: Manages the NexaStream IPTV platform including content licensing, channel provisioning, EPG accuracy, cloud DVR infrastructure, and streaming quality engineering. Handles all customer escalations related to IPTV and on-demand content.

departments.name: Field Operations & Installation Services
departments.description: Coordinates all physical field activities including fiber and DSL installations, equipment upgrades, on-site repairs, and technician dispatch. Responsible for appointment scheduling, SLA adherence, technician quality control, and handling property damage claims.
departments.notes: Includes contract field technicians across regional hubs.

departments.name: Regulatory Affairs & Legal Compliance
departments.description: Ensures NexaLink operates within all applicable federal and state telecommunications regulations (FCC, state utility commissions, CPNI rules, data privacy laws). Handles regulatory complaints, GDPR/CCPA requests, formal legal disputes, and executive-level escalations requiring legal review.
departments.notes: Any complaint referencing the FCC, BBB, state PUC, or an attorney must be auto-routed here.

departments.name: Executive Escalations & Customer Relations
departments.description: Manages high-priority, repeat, or executive-channel escalations. Acts as the ultimate internal escalation layer for cases that have failed resolution at the department level or that involve VIP customers, media exposure risk, class-action flags, or severe service failures.
departments.notes: Receives escalations from all other departments. No direct inbound complaints; escalation-only intake.

escalation_matrix.description: Defines the routing order when a complaint cannot be resolved at the primary department within SLA.
triggers_for_immediate_exec_escalation: Safety risk to customer or property
